title: record-conditioned-gravity: a sourcing law, its computational check, and its testability under realistic conditions
description: A standalone, reproducible package for a record-conditioned sourcing law for semiclassical gravity: the law in closed form, a computational check against the idealized theory it is drawn from, and a realistic-conditions feasibility study for testing it on real optomechanical platforms. Every number, table and figure a paper would use is produced by this repository in a form that can be included directly.
